title: Motion for an extension of time within which to file the briefs on the merits

Via email to dmcnerney@supremecourt.gov

Denise McNerney
Merits Cases Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, DC 20543

Re: Argument date and briefing schedule for Case v. Montana
United States Supreme Court No. 24-624

Dear Ms. McNerney:

 We are counsel of record for the parties in William Trevor Case v . State of Montana,
No. 24-624.  The Court granted certiorari on June 2, 2025.  The parties have consented to an
October 2025 argument date, and understand that the Court is considering this matter for
argument on October 14 or 15.  We would propose the following briefing schedules based on
those potential dates:

Brief October 14 Argument October 15 Argument
Petitioner’s Brief July 28 (10-day extension) July 28 (10-day extension)
Respondent’s Brief Sept. 1 (5-day extension) Sept. 1 (5-day extension)
Reply Brief Oct. 3 (5-day extension) Oct. 3 (5-day extension

We sincerely appreciate your flexibility with scheduling this case.

Respectfully Submitted,


/s/ Christian B. Corrigan
Christian B. Corrigan
Counsel of Record for Respondent


/s/ Fred A. Rowley, Jr.
Fred A. Rowley, Jr.
Counsel of Record for Petitioner
